description: A3 task 14b (#746; REQ-019, REQ-033; completion owner of JOURNEY-019 and JOURNEY-033): every logging moment's writers and the effects layer checked on real routes after TASK-114. The sweep runs task-019 (TASK-019 check-01: all sixteen logging moments on /workout, /summary and Home's rest-day entry, each in Round 7's shared LoggingOverlay over its original writer) and task-045 (TASK-045 check-01: notes, feedback and rest days), and composes the effects layer — the root effects host (src/app/RootLayout.tsx), the one CRT front glass (src/ui/crt-field), the one Echo kernel (src/ui/phosphor-echo.tsx) and the atmosphere — with open dialogs and TASK-108's shared deadline warning (src/ui/countdown-urgency.tsx) in task-033 (TASK-033 check-01; effects reference PRE-002), and reruns TASK-114's task-041 (TASK-041 check-01) as a regression check. check-01 runs src/app/visual-effects-journey.test.tsx and src/ui/phosphor-echo.test.tsx whole (this task owns both, owner decisions of 2026-11-18, decision 3). parity compares the urgency and ladder-long gallery states (gallery bec4454) with the real /workout route over matched data at 320 and 390: one glass in the top layer, the warning's one edge in the dialog's top layer, the Balanced backdrop, a filter-free opaque foreground and no Echo inside the dialog, every word of the open dialog, and captures with every infinite loop held at its start. Owner decisions 2026-11-16 (decision 3: the ladder log opens only after the attempt ends; decision 4: the movement note keeps its fixed 'Movement note' title) and the standing test-update rule of 2026-11-23 govern the carried rewrites, listed in evidence/refinement/task-120/test-ledger.json. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-120 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/app/visual-effects-journey.test.tsx src/ui/phosphor-echo.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

JOURNEY-004: Visual effects off in Settings, then the other screens > shows no Echo, no CRT field and no old scans on Settings, Home and /generate; the blobs stay, still
JOURNEY-004: Visual effects on again, without a reload > restores the Echo, the field and the atmosphere motion with the same preset identities
JOURNEY-004: Visual effects on again, without a reload > falls back to effects on when the stored choice is unknown, and the app still renders
JOURNEY-004: OS reduced motion, live > stops blobs, drift and grain together mid-session; the static glass and Echo stay; no atmosphere scan
JOURNEY-004: OS reduced motion, live > starts still when reduced motion is already on, with the Echo and the static glass
JOURNEY-004: a hidden tab > stops effect work while hidden and resumes the same clocks when shown again
JOURNEY-004: a hidden tab > a hidden tab with effects off stays off when shown
the preset owner > holds the owner-approved live-review preset and nothing else
the preset owner > is not the earlier geometry-check values
the preset owner > is separate from geometry, compositing and lifecycle: the module states no number of its own
the preset owner > offers no per-target blur, strength, offset or colour override
the kernel > installs one filter matching round-3 phosphor-echo.mjs, primitive by primitive
the kernel > adds no drop shadow, glow or other primitive anywhere in the module
the kernel > keeps one definition per document even if a second host mounts
the kernel > is what every rear source references, and only rear sources
silhouette geometry > is the full filled chamfer footprint round 3 paints
rear sources > draw a filled currentColor silhouette behind a framed component, hidden and inert
rear sources > follow the whole card, accent bar included
rear sources > are pointer-inert and keep the exposed echo unclipped
rear sources > duplicate heading text without changing its accessible name
rear sources > nest a glyph viewBox inside the filtered CSS-pixel space, never on it
rear sources > take no fixed hue: colour is the target’s own painted role colour
Visual effects off > leaves no rear source at all, and the real components untouched
